title: Assis
summary: King listed in CFAH-8 Table 6 (Egypt Dynasty 15 (Hyksos)).
description: Ruler of Egypt Dynasty 15 (Hyksos). Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-8 (Table 6, "Integrated Dates for Dynasty 15"); its dates are display only.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

reign.date: Start Co-Rex: 1281; Start Sole-rex: 1252; Death or Deposition: 1232
reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-8: Placing Dynasties 15-18," OSF preprint v1.2 (29 Apr 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/Z5RTD, file CFAH-8_v1.2.pdf, Table 6 "Integrated Dates for Dynasty 15", p. 87
